# Support & Community Guidelines

Thank you for using **MWBA (Make Windows Bootable Again)**!

## Passion Project Notice & Support Boundary

MWBA is an independent, free open-source bench utility created and maintained by **David @ RemarkablePC**. 

Because this tool is provided 100% free of charge and maintained during personal time:

* **No 1-on-1 Technical Support**: We cannot provide private diagnostics, emergency customer drive recovery support, direct email assistance, or guaranteed support via phone, website contact forms, or direct messages.
* **No Emergency Response SLAs**: Field situations and bench questions are reviewed purely at the creator's discretion and personal availability.

## Where to Connect & Get Help

* **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/remarkablepc/MWBA/discussions)**: Have a tricky BCD scenario, filter driver conflict, or donor drive result to share? Join the conversation in GitHub Discussions. Fellow bench technicians and administrators are warmly encouraged to assist one another.
* **Documentation & Guides**: Check our [README.md](README.md) for full descriptions of the audit commands, offline registry repair workflows, and Hyper-V smoke testing.

## How to Support the Project

If MWBA helped rescue an unbootable customer drive or saved you hours on the repair bench, you can support continuous maintenance:
* **[Sponsor on GitHub](https://github.com/sponsors/remarkablepc?uhm=MWBA)**
